name: Sanhua

tierList.prydwen: Hybrid: T2 Tower of Adversity, T3 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: Free 4-star Glacio Sword Hybrid with arguably the fastest Concerto rotation in the game, buffing Basic Attack DMG by 38% on Outro. Deploys ice constructs (Thorn/Prism/Glacier) via Intro/Skill/Ultimate then detonates them all at once with a timing-minigame Heavy Attack for huge Concerto gain.

skills.normalAttack: Basic Attack - Frigid Light (5 hits), Glacio.
skills.resonanceSkill: Eternal Frost - creates an Ice Prism, Glacio hit.
skills.forte: Clarity of Mind - timing-minigame Heavy Attack (Detonate) that explodes all active ice constructs for big Concerto/Resonance Energy gain, expanded 'Frostbite' hit-window via Clarity stacks.
skills.liberation: Glacial Gaze - Glacio hit, creates a Glacier, grants 2 Clarity stacks.
skills.intro: Freezing Thorns - creates an Ice Thorn, Glacio hit.
skills.outro: Silversnow - 38% Basic Attack DMG Deepen to next character for 14s or until swap.

echoSet: Moonlit Clouds (only meta set - 22.5% ATK to next character on Outro, with Impermanence Heron)
substatPriority: Energy Regen (until satisfied, mostly unneeded on Moonlit Clouds)

teams.name: Camellya Team
teams.notes: Extremely close second to Roccia at a fraction of the cost.

teams.name: Encore Team
teams.notes: Sanhua's single best pairing by far - Encore uses her better than nearly any other partner.

teams.name: Brant Hypercarry Team
teams.notes: Natural fit since Brant deals almost exclusively Basic ATK DMG.

rotation: Heavy Attack Concerto: Intro -> Ultimate -> Skill -> Heavy: Detonate x2 -> Outro. At S5+, only 1 Detonate is needed before Echo (swap-cancel) -> Outro.
communityNotes: Prydwen: one of the strongest and most popular Hybrids in the game thanks to an extremely fast rotation, strong Basic ATK buffing, and being fully free with scalable Sequences; main challenge is nailing the Forte timing minigame consistently under her very fast rotation pace.
